rationale: The Evaluator feedback confirms the current candidate's approach to reduce steering oscillations by lowering kd to 0.15 and reducing sensor weights magnitude to [-0.6, -0.3, 0, 0.3, 0.6] is appropriate. The base speed increase to 1.5 aims to improve progress and completion potential while maintaining stability. The proportional gain kp remains at 12 for strong correction, and integral gain ki at 0.18 has been effective. The line_loss strategy remains 'search_left' for consistent recovery. Geometry remains unchanged as no physical issues have been indicated. I expect these changes to further reduce steering oscillations, improve line recovery, and increase progress and completion rates. I request measurements including completion, progress, rms_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to verify these effects and guide any final tuning if needed.
